integrity: The claim is derived exactly from the published invasion-fitness formalism. Literature comparisons distinguish the generic pairwise formalism from narrower public-goods, social-dilemma, finite-strategy, and symbiont models; no claim of exhaustive literature uniqueness is made beyond the documented searches.
scientific_limitations: The payoff is a generic smooth pairwise game and is not asserted to satisfy a social-dilemma or monotone benefit-cost interpretation.
The result is a local adaptive-dynamics branching-point statement; post-branching coexistence, finite populations, large mutations, and endogenous assortment are not analyzed.
The threshold values \(r=\tfrac12\) and \(r=\tfrac23\) are degenerate and are excluded from the strict branching interval.
title: A quadratic pairwise game where assortativity creates an evolutionary branching point
